The main takeaway from our work is that
substance P is a stimulant of carotid body chemoreceptors and that substance P antagonists can attenuate the response to hypoxemia.
SP plays an important role during hypoxia in chemosensatory excitation of the rat carotids, and that this effect is not mediated by changes in blood pressure.
